ambient_events: A door slams somewhere down the hall, and a chain rattles into place.
The dead vending machine emits a single, hopeless click.
description: The runner stops short of the doors as if it lost its nerve. The rose paper has been painted over in a pink that doesn't match. Units 3A to 3D, numbers hanging by single screws. A dead vending machine stands where the luggage trolley was, glass cracked, snacks fossilised. A print of the hotel's own front hangs crooked.

flags.intro_lore: Two flights up from Lowry's bar, the hotel starts telling the truth about itself: the runner gone short, the paper painted over, a vending machine that died guarding snacks nobody will ever eat. Four doors, four locks, four small victories against everything on the other side of them.

name: Third Floor Landing
